verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed https://consensus.app/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary. The site also publishes /llms-full.txt and a machine-readable /.well-known/pricing.md, so an agent has dedicated, agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: per-page markdown variants of the docs (the .md probe returned 404), and independent or community corroboration that agents use these files effectively.
